mentions.name: Sportive chronometry decoder
mentions.description: This embedded device is a decoder for sportive chronometry that uses heavy DSP processing to detect and measure when vehicles pass through the finish line. It runs on a baremetal USB device stack implemented directly in the embedded application.
mentions.problem: Implementing a baremetal USB device stack in an embedded application has proven extremely difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am implementing a baremetal USB device stack in an embedded application and an having a really, really hard time. The device in question is a decoder for sportive chronometry and uses lots of DSP for detecting and measuring when vehicles pass through the finish line.
